sup:70620.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our current offer for your requirements, maintaining our commitment to supporting your business with top-quality service and our extensive product range.

For this offer, we quote a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To provide some background on our pricing calculations, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Your rolling scorecard shows on-time delivery of 85.0% (sc:70620@2026Q3).
Our demand forecast for this part has risen 4.2% (fc:360020@2026-09).
Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 4.39 per unit (po:4500014467-10, po:4500014389-10, po:4500014329-10).

Please find our proposal below.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have reviewed your proposal for a 36-month contract and 90-day payment terms. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position. 

While we note your comments on past orders and delivery performance, our pricing must reflect current costs and the extended terms requested. We can offer €4.94 per unit for this package.

Our current Angebot consists of a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have reviewed your latest proposal and the points from our recent account review meeting. As our costs and capacity constraints remain unchanged, we are unable to offer further concessions on the price. 

Therefore, we must maintain our offer of a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months. Please note that our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. 

We always strive to support your business with our extensive bearing range and dedicated service, and we hope this stable offer works well for your planning. This Angebot stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

Dear customer,

We appreciate your revised offer and your willingness to move. It is always a pleasure working with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, and we greatly value our continued business relationship.

However, as our costs and capacity constraints remain unchanged, we have reached our limit for these extended terms. We must therefore maintain our offer of €4.94 per unit. 

Please note that this is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide accordingly. To confirm the full details, our offer stands at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months. Kindly keep in mind that this offer remains valid for 7 days.

We hope these terms allow us to continue our cooperation and look forward to hearing from you soon.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
